summary: Checked all six estimates against the extraction rules, codebook, complete 656-line markdown conversion (including Appendix A and references), and cited PDF pages. No extraction errors or omitted in-scope outcomes or contrasts were found in the supplied paper. PDF p. 9, Fig. 5 explicitly labels the full-sample AI/Control frequency counts as 635/552 and flexibility counts as 442/313, confirming the extraction despite the reversed outcome labels in the p. 7 prose and reversed use/nonuse wording in the figure caption. These are whole-set counts, not participant means; the extraction documents this distinction. The four individual-output contrasts correctly retain null numerical statistics: the available PDF prints only subgroup coefficients and directs full-sample results to SI Table 3. Analysis-specific participant counts are not printed; the study-level final sample of 225 is printed on p. 4 despite inconsistent completion/exclusion arithmetic. The outcome codes, arms, availability, timing, between-person comparisons, and uncertainty coding are supported. Self-reports, subgroup analyses, process time, scoring validation, and self-selected HAI interaction classes are appropriately excluded. Supplementary Tables 1-6 are absent from the local files and PDF attachments. Attempts to access the article DOI and Oxford repository using urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 both failed with WinError 10013. Verification is therefore limited to the supplied article; no supplementary-table values were assumed.
